reason_for_supersession: canonical main advanced with stronger MicroVM contracts: fsGroup/CSI persistence, separate healthz/readyz, full Pod/Kata-sandbox Tier-2 replacement semantics, rolling-release Kata security and post-admission io.katacontainers.* annotation fencing

current_main_contract_alignment.exact_image_digest: fenced in Pod spec and runtime imageID
current_main_contract_alignment.guest_kernel: recorded and required to differ from host kernel; collector explicitly does not claim this alone proves the independent guest boundary
current_main_contract_alignment.pod_security: host namespaces off; ServiceAccount token automount off; seccomp RuntimeDefault; non-root uid/gid 10001; read-only root; no privilege escalation; drop ALL
current_main_contract_alignment.persistence: fsGroup 10001 + OnRootMismatch fenced; both PVC identities plus StorageClass and CSI driver inventories captured; non-root RW/fsync semantics remain an explicit active probe
current_main_contract_alignment.network: all selecting NetworkPolicies enumerated and hashed; exact default deny required; obvious broad selecting allows rejected; CNI identity/enforcement and active deny/allow probes remain open
current_main_contract_alignment.kata_annotations: effective post-admission io.katacontainers.* annotations default-deny; any admitted annotation must exactly match an explicit CLI allowset and is receipt-hashed
current_main_contract_alignment.kata_security: collector intentionally records Kata runtime version/configuration as unobserved because Kubernetes objects do not establish the current-supported release, hypervisor or shared-filesystem configuration
current_main_contract_alignment.tier2: Pod UID captured; sandbox/VM identity and full replacement remain explicitly unobserved

primary_source_notes: Kubernetes NetworkPolicies selecting a Pod combine additively and require an enforcing network implementation
Kata Pod annotations can modify runtime behavior; upstream documents restricted annotation controls and config allowlists
Kata 4.0+ installs runtime-rs as the default/recommended runtime; exact current-supported version and configuration remain a fresh acceptance-time upstream review gate
next_gate: Run the exact final image on an admitted current-supported Kata/equivalent target; augment this Kubernetes snapshot with independently observed Kata runtime/config/hypervisor identity, CNI identity + active policy probes, persistent-volume non-root RW/fsync probes, and CRI/sandbox identity before and after Tier-2 replacement.
